covered_report_window: Tuesday, October 6, 2026 after the U.S. market close through Wednesday, October 7, 2026 before the U.S. market open. Four qualified after-close reporters; no confirmed Wednesday pre-market reporters.
market_context_summary: U.S. equities were near record highs as oil and Treasury yields eased, but the 10-year yield remained about 5.28% and September FOMC minutes were due Wednesday. Elevated rates remain a headwind for private credit and cyclicals; AI appetite supports PENG but raises crowding risk.

ranked_companies.timing: Tuesday, October 6, 2026 after market close; call 4:30 p.m. ET
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: High bar, crowding, margin or cash-flow miss
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AI infrastructure and integrated-memory momentum support upside, but a sharp pre-earnings rerating means guidance must validate another leg of growth.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $0.77 EPS on $519-$521 million revenue after management raised FY26 growth and EPS guidance in July.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: FY26 lands above the raised range and FY27 AI growth/margins validate the rerating.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A merely in-line print, weaker gross margin, cash conversion, or cautious FY27 outlook triggers a volatility unwind.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Published October option data showed triple-digit implied volatility and roughly 17% expected move; recent flow was mixed-to-bearish despite bullish analyst ratings.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Five recent analysts averaged a $72 target versus about $61, with four buys and one hold.

ranked_companies.timing: Tuesday, October 6, 2026 after market close; call Wednesday 10:00 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Adjusted NII and NAV per share
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Zero fair-value non-accruals and low-bar relief
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Lower portfolio yield, higher funding cost, and prior-quarter NAV/NII erosion create a downside bias despite clean fair-value non-accruals.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Published consensus is about $0.49 EPS and $32 million revenue; the market needs stabilization in adjusted NII and NAV.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Originations, fee income, and credit marks stabilize NAV while non-accruals remain minimal.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: SOFR/spread compression and 8% note issuance further pressure NII, dividend coverage, and NAV.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Reliable event-implied-move data were unavailable; the small-cap BDC structure implies thinner liquidity and gap risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Sparse analyst coverage limits revision signal quality.

ranked_companies.timing: Tuesday, October 6, 2026 after market close; call Wednesday 8:00 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Beer depletion growth and beer margin
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Depressed valuation and easy relief bar
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Softening late-summer beer depletion trends and lowered margin estimates outweigh a depressed valuation and reliable EPS-beat history.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is roughly $3.55-$3.62 EPS on $2.54-$2.57 billion revenue; FY27 comparable EPS guidance was $11.20-$11.90.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Modelo/Corona depletion and beer margins beat a recently lowered bar while FY27 guidance holds.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Negative depletion, inflation, or weaker beer margin forces a guide cut despite an EPS beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Near-term options priced roughly a 5%-6% move, close to but below some recent historical measures.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: EPS estimates fell about 4% over three months; JPMorgan cut its target to $133 and reduced Q2/FY27 estimates.

ranked_companies.timing: Tuesday, October 6, 2026 after market close; call Wednesday 8:30 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Lower prior-quarter adjusted earnings and soft toll demand offset higher selling prices, Sitem contribution, and Kloeckner optionality.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $0.92; investors will focus on underlying margin and acquisition integration rather than headline sales.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Pricing, automotive volumes, and Sitem/Kloeckner synergies lift adjusted margins.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Soft mill/customer demand, electrical-steel weakness, or deal costs depress earnings and cash flow.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: One published options snapshot showed a very wide 26.5% two-week expected move, signaling poor event precision and/or thin markets.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Coverage and revision data are sparse, reducing confidence.

qualified_names.why: Absolute consensus score above 30, reversal risk below 40, low disparity, and primary-source support.

excluded_high_reversal_or_weak_names.reason: Score does not exceed 30 and confidence is low.
